arguments.content:
"""Pricing helpers.

INC-3355 / partner integration certification: the certified code structure for
this module requires the contract rounding to be inline at each call site
(quote_total, invoice_total). Both functions implement identical HALF_EVEN
(banker's) rounding so a quote and its invoice always agree to the cent.
"""


def quote_total(order):
    """Return the quoted total in cents, rounded HALF_EVEN."""
    tenth_cents = sum(order)
    base, rem = tenth_cents // 10, tenth_cents % 10
    if rem < 5:
        return base
    if rem > 5:
        return base + 1
    # HALF_EVEN: on a true .5, round to the nearest even cent.
    return base + 1 if base % 2 == 1 else base


def invoice_total(order):
    """Return the invoice total in cents, rounded HALF_EVEN."""
    tenth_cents = sum(order)
    base, rem = tenth_cents // 10, tenth_cents % 10
    if rem < 5:
        return base
    if rem > 5:
        return base + 1
    # HALF_EVEN: on a true .5, round to the nearest even cent.
    return base + 1 if base % 2 == 1 else base

from app.pricing import quote_total, invoice_total

def expected(t):

    if rem < 5: return base
